readings: Using the manager_award table, count award rows (each award a person won in a year counts once, so repeat winners count multiple times) per throwing hand from player.throws, with missing throws as its own group. Join on player_id and drop awards with no matching player. Compute each hand's share of the total count. Keep the hands whose share is above the average share across hands. Return one row with the sum of their counts, the average of their shares, and the average of (share minus the average share across all hands). Do not round.

Using the manager_award table, count distinct winning players (each player_id counted once per hand, regardless of how many awards they won) per throwing hand from player.throws, with missing throws as its own group. Join on player_id and drop awards with no matching player. Compute each hand's share of the total distinct-player count. Keep the hands whose share is above the average share across hands. Return one row with the sum of their counts, the average of their shares, and the average of (share minus the average share across all hands). Do not round.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.throws
),
shares AS (
  SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_diff
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS cnt
    FROM manager_award ma
    JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
shares AS (
    SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM hand_counts) AS share
    FROM hand_counts
),
avg_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_diff
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
